The camera rolls toward the subject: it grows, the background less so.

A sudden, very fast zoom onto the subject, for impact.

The camera turns right on its axis, sweeping across the scene.
A pan so fast the image blurs, often to cut to the next shot.
The camera tips up on its axis, from the ground to the sky.
The camera tips down on its axis, from the sky to the ground.

The whole camera slides right along the scene: near things pass faster.
The camera travels beside a moving subject, keeping it in frame.
The camera rises on a crane arm, often revealing the scene from above.
The camera lowers on a crane arm, coming down into the scene.

The camera lowers straight down, its angle unchanged.

The camera curves right around the subject, part of a circle.

A high, steady glide over the landscape, as from a helicopter.
A fast, precise move on a motion-control arm, like a commercial shot.

The place first, the subject small
The whole subject in its place

template: {prompt}. {body}, {lens}, {focal}, {aperture}. {movement}. {tempo}. {shot}. {lighting}. {grade}. {era}. {genre}. Cinematic, photorealistic.

label: Dolly zoom in
description: Pushes in while zooming out: the background stretches, the subject holds.

fields.label: Subject
fields.placeholder: the dancer in the red coat

template: Dolly zoom (vertigo effect) on {subject}: the camera dollies in at a {speed} pace while the lens zooms out, the background stretches away and the subject stays the same size in frame. {prompt}

label: Crash zoom in
description: A sudden, fast zoom onto the subject's face.
template: Crash zoom: the camera snaps in very fast onto {subject}, with motion blur, then holds on the close-up. {prompt}

label: Earth zoom out
description: Pulls back from the subject up to orbit.

fields.label: Subject
fields.placeholder: a woman on a rooftop in Paris

template: Continuous zoom out starting close on {subject}, rising through the city, the clouds and the atmosphere until the whole Earth is seen from orbit. One unbroken move. {prompt}

label: FPV drone
description: A fast first-person drone flight through the scene.

fields.label: Flight path
fields.placeholder: dives off the cliff, skims the waves, rises over the boat

template: FPV drone shot, fast and fluid, wide lens with slight fisheye: {path}. {prompt}

label: Orbit
description: Arcs around the subject, left or right, part way or all around.
template: The camera orbits {direction} around {subject}, {arc}, at a steady distance, the subject kept centered. {prompt}

label: Handheld
description: Documentary feel: a slightly shaky camera following the action.

fields.label: Action
fields.placeholder: she walks through the market, looks back

template: Handheld camera, natural micro-shake, documentary style, following the action: {action}. {prompt}

label: Static shot
description: A locked-off camera: only the scene moves.

fields.label: What happens
fields.placeholder: steam rises from the coffee cup

template: Static locked-off camera on a tripod, no camera movement at all. {action}. {prompt}

label: Set on fire
description: Flames spread over the subject, realistic fire and smoke.
template: {subject} catches fire: realistic flames spread across it, embers and smoke rise, the light of the fire flickers on the surroundings. {prompt}

label: Disintegration
description: The subject crumbles into dust carried by the wind.
template: {subject} disintegrates into fine dust particles that drift away on the wind, starting from the edges, until nothing is left. {prompt}

label: Freeze
description: Frost spreads and the subject turns to ice.
template: Frost crystals spread over {subject} until it is frozen solid in clear ice, cold mist around it. {prompt}

label: Turn to metal
description: The subject turns into polished chrome, then melts or holds.
template: {subject} turns into liquid-polished chrome metal from head to toe, reflections sliding over it, then it {end}. {prompt}

label: Explosion
description: A cinematic explosion behind or at the subject.
template: A cinematic explosion bursts from {where}: fireball, shockwave, debris, the subject stays in frame. {prompt}

label: Talking avatar
description: A photo of a person speaks a voice: lip-synced talking head (it needs a human-like face).
template: The person speaks the audio, natural lip-sync and facial expressions, {motion}. {prompt}

label: Custom edit
description: Changes what you describe in a video, the rest stays. Draw on a frame to point at it.
template: {prompt}. Change only that, keep everything else of the video identical.

keyframe.template: {prompt}. Change only that, keep everything else of the image identical.
keyframe.apply: {prompt}, as the keyframe shows. Change only that, keep everything else of the video identical.

label: Restyle
description: Redraws every frame in a style, or in the look of a style of your Library. Motion, camera and framing stay as filmed.

inputs.label: Characters
inputs.phrase: The people, products and clothes of {} keep their exact identity, redrawn in the same style.

template: Redraw every frame of the video in the style of {style}. Keep the motion, camera move, framing, timing, poses and expressions exactly as filmed; only the look changes. {references} {prompt}

keyframe.apply: Redraw every frame of the video in the look of the keyframe: {style}. Keep the motion, camera move, framing, timing, poses and expressions exactly as filmed; only the look changes. {prompt}

label: Extend
description: Continues a video after its end (sequel) or builds what came before (prequel).

fields.label: Join
fields.default: seamless continuity with the video: the same shot, camera and framing

options.value: seamless continuity with the video: the same shot, camera and framing

options.value: a cut to a new camera angle on the same scene and moment
options.label: New shot

template: {next}. {join}. Same characters, place and light as the video. {prompt}

label: Upscale
description: Sharper and larger: precise keeps the original, creative adds detail.
template: {prompt}

keyframe.apply: Relight the whole video as the keyframe shows: {light}. Light and shadows follow the 3D scene through the whole shot, nothing else changes. {prompt}

label: Recolor
description: A new grade, warmer or cooler, more or less color and contrast, and new colors for up to three items. Motion kept.

options.value: cross-processed look, shifted greens and yellows
options.label: Cross-process

options.value: day-for-night grade, dark blue night with moonlit highlights
options.label: Day for night

options.value: matte faded look with lifted blacks
options.label: Matte faded

options.value: neon cyberpunk palette of magenta and cyan

options.value: a warmer, more golden white balance

template: Recolor the video: {grade}, {temperature}, {saturation}, {contrast}, {exposure}, {items}. Keep the motion, framing, timing, light direction and everything else identical. {prompt}

keyframe.template: Recolor the image: {grade}, {temperature}, {saturation}, {contrast}, {exposure}, {items}. Keep the framing, light direction and everything else identical. {prompt}
keyframe.apply: Recolor the whole video as the keyframe shows: {grade}, {temperature}, {saturation}, {contrast}, {exposure}, {items}. Keep the motion, framing, timing, light direction and everything else identical. {prompt}

label: Object swap
description: Replaces a subject, an object, an outfit, a place or a pose with elements of your Library or photos; the action stays. Paint it on a frame to point at it.

inputs.label: Paint what goes
inputs.phrase: the area painted in translucent magenta on {}

template: Replace {old} ({sketch}) {element} {references}, keeping its position, motion and the lighting. Everything else stays identical. {prompt}

keyframe.template: Replace {old} ({sketch}) {element} {references}, at the same place and size, in the same light and perspective. Everything else stays identical. {prompt}
keyframe.apply: Replace {old} {element}, exactly as the keyframe shows it, its whole look included: clothes, colors and shape. Keep its position, motion and the lighting through the whole shot. Everything else stays identical. {prompt}

label: Clean up
description: Removes objects, wires or people you name or paint over on a frame.

inputs.label: Paint what goes
inputs.phrase: The area painted in translucent magenta on {} marks what goes.

fields.label: Remove
fields.placeholder: the boom mic at the top and the man in the background

template: Remove {what} from the whole video and fill the background naturally. {sketch} Nothing else changes. {prompt}

keyframe.template: Remove {what} from the image and fill the background naturally. {sketch} Nothing else changes. {prompt}
keyframe.apply: Remove {what} from the whole video as the keyframe shows, filling the background naturally. Nothing else changes. {prompt}

label: Inpaint
description: Paint over an area on a frame, say what goes there: it changes through the whole shot.

inputs.label: Paint the area
inputs.phrase: the area painted in translucent magenta on {}

template: In the video, change only {sketch}: put {change} {element} {references} there, following the camera and the motion through the whole shot, in the scene's light. No magenta in the result; everything outside that area stays identical. {prompt}

keyframe.template: In the image, change only {sketch}: put {change} {element} {references} there, in the scene's light and perspective. No magenta in the result; everything outside that area stays identical. {prompt}
keyframe.apply: Put {change} {element} where the keyframe shows it, exactly as it looks there, following the camera and the motion through the whole shot, in the scene's light. Everything else stays identical. {prompt}

label: Face swap
description: Puts a face from photos or a character of your Library onto a person of the video; expressions and lip movements stay. Seedance refuses photos of real-looking people.

fields.label: Which person
fields.placeholder: the man in the blue shirt

template: Replace the face of the person {who} in the video with the face of {character} {references}. Keep the head movements, expressions, eye direction, lip movements, lighting and skin tone match; hair, body, clothes and background stay identical. {prompt}

keyframe.template: Replace the face of the person {who} with the face of {character} {references}. Keep the head angle, expression, eye direction, lighting and skin tone match; hair, body, clothes and background stay identical. {prompt}
keyframe.apply: Replace the face of the person {who} with the face of {character} as the keyframe shows it, keeping the head movements, expressions, eye direction and lip movements through the whole shot; hair, body, clothes and background stay identical. {prompt}

label: Remove background
description: Cuts the subject out of every frame: transparent (ProRes 4444 and WebM), or on a flat color. Local and free, about 4 s a frame.

label: Depth map
description: A grayscale depth video, near in white and far in black, for compositing, fog or a 3D effect. Local and free, about 0.3 s a frame.

label: FPS boost
description: More frames, made between the existing ones: smoother motion, or a slow motion. Local and free.

label: SDR to HDR
description: An HDR10 video (HEVC 10-bit, BT.2020 PQ) from an SDR one: highlights stretched up to the peak you pick. A conversion, it adds no detail. Local and free.

label: Reframe
description: Another aspect ratio, cropped around the point you pick. Local and free.
